=== 
Run OCI images as Nitro Sandbox microVMs with a Podman-compatible command line

Usage: mj-worker microvm <COMMAND>

Commands:
  info       Report the engine and host facts
  pull       Fetch an image and flatten it into a bootable disk
  image      Image commands
  run        Create and start a VM
  exec       Run a command in a running VM
  cp         Copy files between the host and a running VM
  container  Container (VM) commands
  ps         List VMs
  start      Start stopped VMs from their retained disks
  stop       Stop VMs
  rm         Remove VMs
  volume     Volume commands
  help       Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -h, --help     Print help
  -V, --version  Print version
exit=125
=== --help

exit=0

=== help run
Create and start a VM

Usage: mj-worker microvm run [OPTIONS] --name <NAME> <IMAGE> [COMMAND]...

Arguments:
  <IMAGE>       
  [COMMAND]...  

Options:
  -d, --detach                       
      --name <NAME>                  
  -l, --label <LABELS>               
      --cpus <CPUS>                  
  -m, --memory <MEMORY>              
  -e, --env <ENV>                    
  -v, --volume <VOLUMES>             
  -u, --user <USER>                  
  -w, --workdir <WORKDIR>            
      --pull <PULL>                  
      --platform <PLATFORM>          
      --init                         Accepted: the guest agent is always an init
      --stop-signal <STOP_SIGNAL>    Accepted when KILL: stopping a VM always kills it
      --cap-add <CAP_ADD>            Accepted with no effect: the VM is the isolation boundary
      --cap-drop <CAP_DROP>          
      --security-opt <SECURITY_OPT>  
      --pids-limit <PIDS_LIMIT>      Accepted with no effect: each VM has its own kernel and process table
  -h, --help                         Print help
exit=0
=== help run extra
error: unrecognized subcommand 'extra'

Usage: mj-worker microvm run [OPTIONS] --name <NAME> <IMAGE> [COMMAND]...

For more information, try '--help'.
exit=125
=== help container replace-root
Replace a stopped VM's root disk with a clone of another image, keeping its volumes (the controller's retained-storage image upgrade)

Usage: mj-worker microvm container replace-root <COMMAND>

Commands:
  stage    Record the target image and keep it from `image prune`; prints its id
  apply    Swap the root disk of the stopped VM; prints the VM's new id
  release  Delete the previous root disk and the record
  help     Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -h, --help  Print help
exit=0
=== help help
Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Usage: mj-worker microvm help [COMMAND]...

Arguments:
  [COMMAND]...  Print help for the subcommand(s)
exit=0
=== help help extra
error: unrecognized subcommand 'extra'

Usage: mj-worker microvm help [COMMAND]...
exit=125
=== info --help
Report the engine and host facts

Usage: mj-worker microvm info [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --format <FORMAT>  Only `json` is supported
  -h, --help             Print help
exit=0
=== pull --help
Fetch an image and flatten it into a bootable disk

Usage: mj-worker microvm pull [OPTIONS] <IMAGE>

Arguments:
  <IMAGE>  

Options:
      --platform <PLATFORM>  
  -q, --quiet                Accepted; the image id is the only output either way
  -h, --help                 Print help
exit=0

  help          Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

  -h, --help  Print help

=== container replace-root --help
Replace a stopped VM's root disk with a clone of another image, keeping its volumes (the controller's retained-storage image upgrade)

Usage: mj-worker microvm container replace-root <COMMAND>

Commands:
  stage    Record the target image and keep it from `image prune`; prints its id
  apply    Swap the root disk of the stopped VM; prints the VM's new id
  release  Delete the previous root disk and the record
  help     Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -h, --help  Print help
exit=0
=== container replace-root stage --help
Record the target image and keep it from `image prune`; prints its id

Usage: mj-worker microvm container replace-root stage [OPTIONS] --operation <OPERATION> <NAME> <IMAGE>

Arguments:
  <NAME>   
  <IMAGE>  

Options:
      --operation <OPERATION>  The controller's operation id; every step of one replacement names it
      --label <LABELS>         Labels the swap adds to the VM
  -h, --help                   Print help
exit=0
=== container replace-root apply --help
Swap the root disk of the stopped VM; prints the VM's new id

Arguments:
  <NAME>  

Options:
      --operation <OPERATION>  
  -h, --help                   Print help
exit=0

      --operation <OPERATION>

=== ps --help
List VMs

Usage: mj-worker microvm ps [OPTIONS]

Options:
  -a, --all               Include VMs that are not running
      --filter <FILTERS>  `label=KEY` or `label=KEY=VALUE`; repeated filters must all match
      --format <FORMAT>   `json`, or a template applied to each VM
  -h, --help              Print help
exit=0

=== stop -h
Stop VMs

Usage: mj-worker microvm stop [OPTIONS] <NAMES>...

Arguments:
  <NAMES>...  

Options:
  -t, --time <TIME>  Seconds the guest has to flush and power off before the VM is killed
      --ignore       
  -h, --help         Print help
exit=0
=== rm --help
Remove VMs

Usage: mj-worker microvm rm [OPTIONS] <NAMES>...

Arguments:
  <NAMES>...  

Options:
  -f, --force    
      --ignore   
  -v, --volumes  Also remove the VM's named volumes
  -h, --help     Print help
exit=0
